", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u006-r0020", "tag": "p", "text": "“And this isn’t an asylum? I mean, it isn’t a place where they cure crazy people?”", "sha256": "d243b768d4c54b226a3fa048db5af96a958c596d4ec666284a6df08422ac0496", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[10]/p[20]", "source_html": "

One thing at a time, is my motto—and just play that thing for all it is worth, even if it’s only two pair and a jack.
